Every business that registers in France describes its activity in a few words, and INSEE must turn that description into one of about 750 codes of the national activity classification (NAF, the French version of NACE). This **APE code** shapes business statistics, national accounts and part of the regulation applied to the business.

Since the end of 2022, this coding has been done by a machine learning model, called in real time by the Sirene business register. This note reviews the **MLOps pipeline** behind it:

- how the data is prepared and cleaned;
- how the model is trained, packaged, deployed and monitored;
- how human expertise and large language models keep its quality under control;
- how the whole system is retrained without regressions.
